summary: The audit checks one of the three minors (General, Thermosciences or Mechanical Design), each course with a C or better. Checked by hand: the 2.7 combined GPA, and that no course also counts toward another degree program; if a listed course already counts for your major, replace it with another course from the program sheet and move it in. ME majors cannot add the Mechanical Design minor.

program.why: Grading: "The minimum grade in each course is a C."
